Name: Xtardew Valley - Unofficial 1.4 Compatibility Fix
Author: SummerChu
Description:
This is a compatibility fix to Xtardew Valley made by Pseudodiego.

There is no additional content, only a fix to what Pseudodiego has made so far.
Until they fix it, I have taken it upon myself to (try) to fix what was broken.

[b]Note: [/b]This has not been tested, however, so there may still be complications.
